DSourceKernel.source_kernel_trace_global_connection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2}
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
        Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x) nu ∧
          ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x ∂nu =
            Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (A F - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (A F)))

DSourceKernel.residualKernel_global_connection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2}

  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (freeKernel : X → X → ℂ) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hfree : (fun x => ↑↑(A F) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x => ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), freeKernel x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu)
  (hint : ∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂nu, Integrable (fun y => freeKernel x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y))) nu) :
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta;
  have P := 1 - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑(A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), DSourceKernel.residualKernel nu b (E T) A freeKernel x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop (nhds ((P.comp A) F))

            (fun y => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y)) V (↑↑U)
